meta.name: hivemind-goals
meta.description: Create, track and update team goals + KPIs via the Deeplake virtual filesystem at memory/goal/ and memory/kpi/. Use whenever the user mentions a goal, objective, KPI, target, milestone, or asks to track progress on something measurable. ALSO use when the user says "task", "todo", "work item", "remind me to", "fix X", or any actionable work item — the goal system replaced the legacy `hivemind tasks` CLI and now covers both objectives and tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并追踪团队目标与关键成果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要管理团队目标、KPI和任务进度
copy.tagline_en: Create and track team goals and key results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage team goals, KPIs, and task progress

howto.what: Claude 能通过 Deeplake 虚拟文件系统创建、追踪和更新团队目标与 KPI，还能处理任务、待办事项等。它替代了旧的 hivemind tasks 命令，现在统一管理目标和任务。
howto.when: 当你提到目标、KPI、里程碑、可衡量的进度，或说出“任务”、“待办”、“提醒我”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新目标：下个月完成用户调研。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个 UUID 并写入目标文件。

say.text: 列出我目前所有的目标和 KPI。
say.note: Claude 会读取对应路径下的文件并展示。

say.text: 把这个 KPI 的当前值更新为 3。
say.note: Claude 会编辑相应 KPI 文件。

howto.what_en: Claude can create, track, and update team goals and KPIs via the Deeplake virtual filesystem at memory/goal/ and memory/kpi/. It also handles tasks and to-dos, replacing the old hivemind tasks CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention a goal, objective, KPI, milestone, measurable progress, or say "task", "todo", "remind me", etc.

say_en.text: Create a new goal: finish user research by next month.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a UUID and write the goal file.

say_en.text: List all my current goals and KPIs.
say_en.note: Claude will read the relevant files and display them.

say_en.text: Update this KPI's current value to 3.
say_en.note: Claude will edit the corresponding KPI file.
